pass.answer: Any non-empty value disables color, so NO_COLOR=0 turns color off too.
Check presence only: if NO_COLOR is set and not empty, print no ANSI color regardless of its value. Let --color override it.

fail.answer: Treat NO_COLOR=0 as false and keep color on; only NO_COLOR=1 disables it.
Respect NO_COLOR by disabling color when it is set.
